answer.justification: Only logit-level data is available. Top-1 agreement is 0.955 and sequence agreement is 0.688, both inside the quantized range (0.945-0.955 and 0.67-0.70) and above the fine-tuned and system-prompted ranges (at most 0.938 and 0.908). KL is 0.030 and TV is 0.038. Both are slightly below the quantized ranges (0.039-0.071 and 0.048-0.055) but well below fine-tuned (KL at least 0.081) and system-prompted (KL at least 0.197). Base is ruled out because every value is non-zero. Fine-tuned is the closest alternative, since its top-1 agreement tops out at 0.938 and its KL starts at 0.081. The Token-DiFR gap of 0.052 and raw-score shift ratio of 3.2 are somewhat off the quantized ranges, which lowers confidence a little.
